subject: general
question: A, B and C can complete a piece of work in 20, 24 and 30 days, respectively. The number of days they take to finish it if they work together will be :
solution:
**Given:**

Time is taken by A to complete a work = 20 days 

Time is taken by B to complete a work = 24 days 

Time is taken by C to complete a work = 30 days 

**Formula Used:**

Total work = Efficiency × Total time taken

**Calculation:** 

The LCM for 20, 24, 30 is (120)
